parts.effect: Whenever the unit Consolidates, if it can end that move in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of an enemy unit, its models can move 3" further, for the rest of the phase. If the unit is in your army's [Synapse Range](vsdata:ability/tyranids.synapse) and out of Engagement Range of every enemy unit, it can move up to 6" with a [normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move) in place of that consolidation move.

data.summary:
**When:** [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), before a **TYRANIDS** unit of yours makes a [consolidation move](vsdata:core-rule/consolidation-move).

**Target:** That **TYRANIDS** unit.

**Effect:** Whenever the unit Consolidates, if it can end that move in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of an enemy unit, its models can move 3" further, for the rest of the phase. If the unit is in your army's [Synapse Range](vsdata:ability/tyranids.synapse) and out of Engagement Range of every enemy unit, it can move up to 6" with a [normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move) in place of that consolidation move.
